description: Agricultural Conservation Planning Framework (ACPF) Toolbox is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USDA Agricultural Research Service, National Laboratory for Agriculture and the Environment; Conservation Professional Training Program; Iowa State University. This free ArcGIS toolbox leverages high-resolution geo-spatial data to help conservation planners, landowners, and researchers better manage watershed runoff while supporting agricultural production. The toolbox is used in hundreds of watersheds across the Corn Belt to inform and engage local producers in agricultural conservation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
